mission.title: Our Mission
paragraphs: At AIKavach, our mission is to help professionals develop practical skills to secure modern AI systems. We deliver instructor-led training that combines technical expertise with real-world experience, enabling participants to understand, assess, and protect AI-powered applications used in today's enterprises.

Our programs are designed for security professionals, software engineers, cloud architects, AI developers, penetration testers, auditors, and organizations seeking to strengthen their AI security capabilities.

osai.title: OSAI - Offensive Security AI Training
osai.description: Our flagship OSAI (Offensive Security AI) program focuses on the security of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and enterprise AI platforms.
